overview: Mexico is among the most visited destinations in the Americas, and the range is part of the appeal — colonial cities with centuries of layered history, Caribbean and Pacific coastlines, desert and jungle, all within a few hours of each other.

Entry requirements depend on your passport, your purpose of travel and how you arrive, so check the current rules for your nationality before booking. Confirm them with Mexico's official authorities before you travel.

attractions.name: Chichén Itzá
attractions.description: One of the New Seven Wonders of the World and one of the most visited archaeological sites in Mexico.

attractions.name: Tulum
attractions.description: Maya ruins perched directly above Caribbean beaches, a setting that stands out in the region.

attractions.name: Mexico City Zócalo & Templo Mayor
attractions.description: The historic heart of the capital, built atop the ruins of the Aztec empire's main temple.

attractions.name: Teotihuacán
attractions.description: Ancient pyramid city just outside Mexico City, home to the Pyramid of the Sun.

attractions.name: Playa del Carmen
attractions.description: A laid-back base for exploring the Riviera Maya's beaches and cenotes.

overview: France is among the most visited countries in the world by international arrivals, and Paris is only part of the draw — the French Riviera, the châteaux of the Loire Valley, and the wine regions of Bordeaux and Burgundy all attract their own steady stream of travelers.

As part of the Schengen Area, France's short-stay entry rules are coordinated with other European countries, so a trip that spans several countries may be subject to the same conditions. Confirm the rules for your passport before you travel.

attractions.name: Eiffel Tower
attractions.description: One of the most-visited paid monuments in the world, and the defining symbol of Paris.

attractions.name: Louvre Museum
attractions.description: One of the world's most-visited museums, and home to the Mona Lisa.

attractions.name: Palace of Versailles
attractions.description: The opulent former royal residence just outside Paris, with gardens stretching over 800 hectares.

attractions.name: Notre-Dame Cathedral
attractions.description: A masterpiece of French Gothic architecture, and one of the most iconic sights on the Seine.

attractions.name: French Riviera
attractions.description: The glamorous Mediterranean coastline stretching from Cannes to Menton.
